title: Full trip priced: 4 options, 2 fit the budget
summary: Nothing held or booked. Every option uses the same Air Canada nonstops and the 11 AM FlixBus. The difference is fare class and whether the Boston room is private or a dorm.
sourceEvidence:
[5:38 PM] DECISION: Full trip is priced. Nothing held or booked. All-in CAD, flights + bus + 8 nights:
A. CA$1,429 (fits): Basic fare + private rooms in both cities. Catch: personal item only (no carry-on) and no seat pick, so no guaranteed window.
B. CA$1,372 (fits, cheapest): Basic fare + private room NYC + shared dorm in Boston. Saves $57 vs A for a big comfort drop.
C. CA$1,652 (over by ~$152): Standard fare (carry-on, 1st checked bag, free window seat pick) + private rooms in both cities.
D. CA$1,595 (over by ~$95): Standard fare + private room NYC + Boston dorm.
Same in all: Air Canada nonstops, YYZ-LGA Sat Oct 10 4:35-6:10 PM and BOS-Billy Bishop Sun Oct 18 9:40-11:36 AM, plus the 11 AM FlixBus on Oct 14.
My pick: A, if you can pack 8 days into a backpack. It's the only way under $1,500 with private rooms. If you want a real bag and a window seat, C, and raise the cap ~$150.
Deadline: none held; fares and rooms can move or sell out anytime, so ideally decide tomorrow morning.
Two things to know about the rooms: NYC Manhattan hotels started around $864 for 4 nights, so the NYC room is an Airbnb private room in Newark, NJ (CA$388, ~25-30 min to Manhattan by PATH train). That bends your central rule, so say if it's a dealbreaker. Boston is a private room with private bath in Medford (CA$497, free cancellation, ~15 min on the Red Line). Also the return is a morning flight; later ones cost more.
